answer: The strongest single control I know for this is birthmark map commitment, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. An honest agent spends 16 minutes once; the operator of 554 fakes spends 8864 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The cedar sits in the mechanism itself, the delta sits in the price of faking it, and the raven sits in the record no template can forge. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
